question: With the stock-account fees confirmed on 2026-10-25 (commission 0.0000854, 5-yuan minimum on commission only, stamp duty and transfer fee separate), how large is the 400k-model vs 200k-scaled paired gap and the 200k drag vs theory under share-count fees?
scope: Fee-rate rerun of the 2026-10-23 share-count audit on the frozen Oct-16 stock inputs; not alpha selection, no production change

scenario_roles.minimum_5: control: reproduces 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-23 with the old 2bp assumption
scenario_roles.confirmed_20261025: primary: confirmed commission 0.0000854 with a 5-yuan minimum on commission only; stamp duty 0.1% before 2023-08-28 and 0.05% after on sells; transfer fee 0.002% before 2022-04-29 and 0.001% after on both sides

variants.archived_value_delta: only for the archived fee scenarios
variants.share_delta_band_0.00: integer shares carried; order only when the target share count differs from the held count

band_rule: no-trade bands are not used (2026-10-23 result); band 0 only
metrics: paired terminal gap (V400_end/(2*V200_end)-1): min p05 median p95 max, all and clean windows
per leg: relative NAV deviation vs the continuous no-fee 50-name theory, tracking error, orders per month, fees
sample_unit: paired 12-month window; 114 overlapping windows are not independent
qa: archived script and input hashes; archived value-delta replay equals Oct-16 rolling metrics; band-0 share ledger equals the archived path with no fees; archived minimum-5 paired median equals Oct-19; Decimal ratio recomputation
limits: same archived economic monthly ledger: adjusted-return valuation, month-end same-close sizing
fees as confirmed by the business owner on 2026-10-25, not yet checked against a broker statement; transfer fee is the statutory rate
dividend tax and broker-specific charges not modelled
no fills, slippage, T+1, suspensions, limit moves or rejections
stopping_rule: run once; report both scenarios; no parameter change after seeing results
